# PhysicalReservoirTransientDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The time-evolving response of a physical system (e.g., ring oscillator, memristor array, or photonic cavity) used as a computational resource for signal encoding and transformation. Exploits natural physical phenomena (delay, nonlinearity, memory) to perform computation in the interconnect fabric, reducing digital overhead in TCC/iNEST.
